svg.title: Magikarp evolution and base stats
svg.desc: Magikarp: Water, HP/Atk/Def/SpA/SpD/Spe 20/10/55/15/20/80, total 200; Gyarados: Water / Dragon, HP/Atk/Def/SpA/SpD/Spe 105/180/100/60/105/90, total 640; Gyarados awakened: Water / Dragon, HP/Atk/Def/SpA/SpD/Spe 115/200/110/60/115/100, total 700

g.text: ZERO TO LEGEND / ORIGINAL STARTER GUIDE
Base stats shown. Your partner's actual stats also depend on level, nature, IVs, EVs and earned growth.
Earned growth reaches +30 to each calculated stat at level 30. It is separate from the totals above.
Awakening requires the Lake of Rage story encounter and an evolved original partner. Normal colors shown.
